title: Elokapina / Extinction Rebellion Finland Emergency Brake road blockade for climate action
participants_original: Police estimated about 150 at the initial Unioninkatu blockade; Yle reported around 200 at the demonstration overall. Elokapina reported 51 detained, not total attendance.
threshold_50_evidence: Helsinki Police reported an approx. 150-person roadblock; Yle reported a few hundred total. Both support threshold.

start_date.summary: All sources date event to 3 October 2020.

end_date.summary: Helsinki Police says the protest ended at about 19:00 on Saturday.

location.summary: Road blockade at Unioninkatu, then Kaisaniemenkatu, Helsinki.

demands.summary: Demanded Finnish government climate action / declaration of climate emergency and Paris Agreement compliance.

participants.summary: Yle reported a few hundred total; Police reported about 150 at a roadblock. Conservative lower figure retained.

threshold_50.summary: Official police statement reports approximately 150 people at the Unioninkatu roadblock.

state_target.summary: Organizer explicitly demanded action by the Finnish government.

state_response.summary: Police used OC spray, dispersed/removed demonstrators, and detained 51; protest ended after the action.

protester_violence.summary: Organizer describes its roadblock as nonviolent; no independent finding of protester violence is recorded.

notes: Single-day action. Autumn Rebellion planning dated 25 Sep is not coded as an event; the public roadblock is evidenced on 3 Oct. No cross-month physical continuation established.

title: Järkeä Jyväskylä/JHL campaign protest and political strike against municipal layoffs and service cuts (gathering details unresolved)
location: Jyväskylä; campaign sources mention city hall / Kirkkopuisto, but location/date of the specific gathering are not fixed
organizer: Julkisten ja hyvinvointialojen liitto (JHL) / Järkeä Jyväskylä campaign
participants_original: The JHL magazine initially reported about 550 strike participants; the later Labour Court judgment records 378. Neither is a public-gathering count. The later campaign report mentions a city-hall demonstration but gives no count/date.
threshold_50_evidence: Not established. Strike participants cannot be treated as a simultaneous public gathering; cumulative campaign activity is not a headcount.

start_date.summary: JHL magazine reports the strike took place Friday 30 October; public gathering date is not stated.

location.summary: Campaign is in Jyväskylä; November report later mentions a demonstration outside City Hall and a Kirkkopuisto gathering, without identifying which date/action.

demands.summary: Against municipal layoffs, long furloughs, employment-term changes and service cuts; calls for city decision-makers to negotiate and preserve services.

participants.summary: Motiivi initially reported about 550 strike participants; the subsequent Labour Court judgment records 378. Both counts concern striking workers and not a public-gathering crowd.

state_target.summary: Jyväskylä city government/council budget and employment/service decisions.

threshold_50.summary: No number for a specific public gathering. Earlier campaign planning involved around 20 activists; no threshold inferred.

notes: Mass-gathering eligibility is unresolved. Keep the 30 October strike and public protest campaign distinct from any uncounted city-hall/Kirkkopuisto gathering. October/November discrete event ownership is also unresolved; no claim of qualifying threshold.
